description: This file is a plugin for the Smarty template engine, implementing a 'capitalize' modifier that capitalizes the first letter(s) of each word in a string with options for handling digits and case restoration.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_capitalize
methods.description: Main function to capitalize words in a string with options for handling digits and case.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_mbconvert_cb
methods.description: Callback to convert a matched string segment to uppercase using mb_convert_case.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_mbconvert2_cb
methods.description: Callback to convert a matched string segment to uppercase, used for hyphenated words.

methods.name: smarty_mod_cap_ucfirst_cb
methods.description: Callback to uppercase the first character of a match.
